the pleasantness of sounds in multi-source environments is determined by the pleasantness of the individual sounds, their loudness, and the interaction between the sounds.
the pleasantness of a complex sound environment is determined by the sum of its single sound sources.
the assessment of sound quality is a highly complex task that cannot be explained by a simple summation model.

pleasantness of sound combinations can be predicted from single ratings with a high accuracy.
